name: 2026 City Budget
one_line: 2026 budget adopted 30-19 on 2025-12-20; later amendments passed near-unanimously; further transfers pending October 2026.

name: Parking Meters
one_line: Council approved CPM ownership transfer to Stonepeak (46-3) and pension allocation of meter payments (44-6), alongside routine meter ordinances.

name: Police Accountability
one_line: Council expanded COPA's Welcoming City investigative powers (50-0), passed CPD restrictions (28-21), approved new COPA chief; FY2027 budget pending.

name: Speed Limits
one_line: Street-level 20 mph speed limits passed 49-0; citywide residential speed policy and stop-sign warrant compliance remain unresolved.

name: Tipped Minimum Wage
one_line: Council passed SO2026-0024043 (49-1) freezing the 24% tip credit through 2028, phasing out by 2030; enforcement details remain open.

name: Housing and Homelessness
one_line: Council shifted homelessness reporting to the Mayor's Office, approved Heritage Woods sale and several multifamily funding ordinances; Flexible Housing Pool funding remains open.

name: Ballot Referenda
one_line: Gunshot detection and festival referenda adopted 49-0 on 2026-07-15; 100-day office question re-referred 15-30, unresolved.

name: Gas Station Zoning
one_line: Council passed gas station zoning bans (48-1, 50-0, 49-0); special use approval required; ward-level expansions remain open.
